questions.question: From what will a shoot come forth in Isaiah 11?
What peaceful image describes the coming kingdom in Isaiah 11?
options: The wolf shall dwell with the lamb, and a little child shall lead them
The mighty eagle shall soar high above the holy mountains of Zion
The lion shall devour the helpless lamb, and not one shall be spared
The frightened deer shall flee away from the hunter through the field
questions.answer: The wolf shall dwell with the lamb, and a little child shall lead them
